summary: Verified the tier-accurate wheel surround end-to-end on web. Backend: 10/10 pytest checks pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_wheel_glow.py — kiosk POST /api/kiosk/leads returns EXACTLY {id, spin_available} (privacy contract), GET /api/kiosk/leads/{id}/glow returns ONLY {glow} with a hex (no tier word/number/score/dollar leaked); glow returns '#CBD5E1' for an unmatched lead, one of {#34D399,#10B981,#047857} for NPI 1528194255 (GREEN 340B), and '#EF4444' for NPI 1003000126 (Enkeshafi, RED 340B); admin PUT /api/admin/settings {key:'wheel_tier_glow',value:false} makes glow return {glow:null} and toggling back to true restores the color; name+location matching: multi-candidate Adams/GA/M is disambiguated to match_status='confirmed' + real npi + non-GREY tier when the doctor supplies a unique city, and stays unresolved/GREY (glow='#CBD5E1') when the city is omitted; one-spin enforcement holds (2nd spin returns error='already_spun'). Frontend /wheel/{id}: root container's background style is a linear-gradient built from the tier hex (verified inline styles rgb(85,89,95)->rgb(142,149,158) for GREY, rgb(22,89,64)->rgb(36,148,107) for GREEN #34D399, rgb(100,29,29)->rgb(167,48,48) for RED #EF4444 — all matching the shade(hex, 0.42/0.7) math in Wheel.js), and the [data-testid=wheel-glow] radial-gradient overlay is present with the correct rgba tier color. With wheel_tier_glow disabled the root has no inline background and falls back to the default emerald tailwind gradient, and the wheel-glow overlay is not rendered. Screenshots captured for grey/green/red/toggle-off states.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_kiosk.py L333-351 lead_glow: correctly returns ONLY {glow: hex|null}, respects admin toggle via get_setting('wheel_tier_glow', True), and picks the higher-priority tier hex using the 340B/RPM priority ladder GREEN<YELLOW<BLUE<RED<GREY. Safe default '#CBD5E1' when tier hex missing.

routes_kiosk.py L140-160 _match_physician: name+state candidates narrowed by city with a strict single-city-match rule -> 'confirmed'. If city is not supplied or does not uniquely disambiguate, falls back to the original collision-based status. Correctly avoids marking multi-candidate as confirmed.
routes_kiosk.py L247 privacy contract: still returns ONLY {id, spin_available} — no leakage.

Wheel.js L185/L193-199: root background gradient uses the shade() helper (0.42 and 0.7 multipliers) which is why the raw hex digits do not appear in the inline style — verified the math for grey/green/red. wheel-glow overlay uses the raw hex with 0x55 alpha suffix which is fine.
Wheel.js gracefully degrades when glow is null (default emerald gradient class), and does not render the wheel-glow overlay in that case — verified in the toggle-off run.

GREEN anchor: NPI 1528194255. RED anchor: NPI 1003000126. rca of the issue: The originally reported symptom (unmatched Sam Thakkar showed a green surround) was caused by the wheel page's default fixed emerald tailwind gradient making the subtle grey radial-gradient overlay invisible. Backend scoring was already correct (GREY -> '#CBD5E1'). The fix moves the ambient tier color to the entire root background via inline style derived from GET /api/kiosk/leads/{id}/glow, so grey leads now show a slate-grey surround, red shows red, green shows green. Verified visually and via inline-style inspection.
